mira: Heads-up — bringing up Saffron's customer LoRA bundle. Quick compatibility check before we flip traffic.
raj: Thanks. Which base model variant are we targeting? 7B-int4 or 13B-int8?
mira: 7B-int4 for flow latency requirements. We ran a local merge with our lora-merge tool.
sam: paste the exact merge command?
mira: `python tools/lora_merge.py --base redwood/7b-v1-int4 --adapter saffron-lora.tar --out tmp/saffron-7b-int4-merged`
olivia: quick note — adapter was trained with HF tokenizer-v3, base uses tokenizer-v2. Did we run tokenization alignment?
mira: Good catch. I applied `scripts/token_align.py --from v3 --to v2` but might've missed special tokens.
raj: Eval pack results? Any regressions on customer prompts?
mira: Running quick-eval-pack-3 (50 prompts). Summary attached below.

```\n# quick-eval-pack-3 summary
perplexity: base 12.3 -> merged 12.8
avg_response_latency: 240ms -> 260ms
exact-match (kbqa subset): 0.81 -> 0.78
hallucination_score: 0.09 -> 0.11
```

mira: Not great on perplexity and EM. Small increase in hallucination.
sam: Could be due to int4 kernel mismatch or KV cache layout after merge. Any warnings in merge logs?
mira: Merge log shows a shape mismatch warning that we coerced: `warning: adapter weight shape mismatch, broadcasting` but no hard fail.
olivia: Broadcasting smells dangerous. We should re-run merge with strict shape checks and resave. Also check whether the adapter used row-wise vs column-wise LoRA config.
raj: If we remerge, try `--strict-shapes` flag and then quantize with the same bitpack used during training.
mira: Will do. Also want to run the 'prefix-caching' micro-benchmark — merged model lost ~8% throughput in our batch size=8 traces.
sam: Could be kernel fallback. Add `export RW_INFER_DEBUG=kernel_fallback` and check logs.
deploy-bot: deploy-candidate saffron-7b-int4-merged created by mira at 2034567897. CI: 12/15 checks passed.
olivia: Which three CI checks failed?
mira: `tokenization-consistency`, `kv-cache-smoketest`, `throughput-regression`
raj: Blocking ones are tokenization-consistency and kv-cache. Throughput we can mitigate but not ignore.
sam: Plan: (1) remerge with strict shapes + aligned tokenizer; (2) run kv-cache smoketest locally; (3) re-run quick-eval-pack including a dedicated hallucination test set; (4) if stable, push canary to 5% on Dedicated.
mira: Agreed. I'll open a PR with the remerge flags and tag @sam @olivia for review. ETA: today EOD.
olivia: If we remerge and still see hallucination bump, we may need to stitch adapter instead of merging — cheaper to ship and likely preserves base behavior. Add stitch as fallback plan.
raj: Add measurement note: capture token-level logprobs on failing prompts so we can diff.
mira: Will capture logs and attach to the PR. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
sam: Ping me when PR is up.
mira: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/2314 (remerge + strict shapes).
deploy-bot: CI status updated for PR 2314: running.
raj: Nice, thanks.
